thread:
mira: quick note: brought up mosaic-v1 q4 on staging and our short multilingual suite flagged a reproducible quality drop for ja/zh-Hant and a weird parenthesis flip in en->ar. sharing repro and a tiny sample. anyone seen tokenizer/packaging detok mismatches like this with quant builds?

mira: repro command:
```
./eval_locales --model=mosaic-v1 --quant=q4 --locales=ja,zh-Hant,ar \
  --dataset=short-locals-2026 --metrics=bleu,chrf --seed=2026 --batch=48
```

mira: snapshot (float -> q4):
```
locale   float_bleu  q4_bleu   float_chrf  q4_chrf
ja       31.8        27.1      48.9        43.5
zh-Hant  29.0        24.4      45.6        40.0
ar       40.8        39.5      (N/A)       (N/A)
```

mira: tiny failing examples:
- ja src: "一人は年末にパジェンに行きます。"
  q4_out: "一人は 年末 にパジェンに行きます。"  (extra spaces between kanji compound)

- zh-Hant src: "今天、測試，請確認。"
  q4_out: "今天 、 測試， 請 確認。"  (over-splitting around ideographic punctuation)

- en->ar mixed src: "We discussed (الاجتماع) yesterday."
  q4_out: "We discussed )الاجتماع( yesterday."  (parens flipped around Arabic run)

tom: thanks, this looks like the same empty-token / resegmentation pattern. can you run tokenize-diff against the bundle-embedded tokenizer and the runtime lib in the q4 image?

mira: did that. results: 
```
float tokenize("一人は年末にパジェンに行きます。") -> ["一人は","年末","に","パジェン","に","行き","ます","。"]
q4   tokenize("一人は年末にパジェンに行きます。") -> ["一人","","人","は","年","","末","に","パ","ジ","ェ","ン","に","行","き","ま","す","。"]
```

cheng: yep that's the empty-token insertion and single-char splitting. packaging note: model-bundle hash is identical across images but the runtime tokenizers package differs: float used tokenizers@2.3.0, q4 image includes tokenizers@2.1.7. bundler currently doesn't enforce runtime checksum.

yasmin: parenthesis flip is worrying. my hunch: token-level resegmentation yields zero-width tokens that confuse our post-detok bidi normalization, so RTL runs get re-ordered relative to surrounding punctuation.

tom: short-term mitigation options: (1) add a detok post-filter in eval harness that collapses empty tokens and strips stray ZWSP/ZWJ before scoring; (2) block index/build or canary if tokenized sequences for a sample corpus diverge beyond a threshold. both help buy time.

mira: i'm prototyping a detok filter now that removes empty tokens, collapses adjacent single-char kana into likely pairs (heuristic), and normalizes punctuation before scoring. will rerun canary after patch.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout updated: rollout_id=rl-2026-2222, hosts=3/3 updated, metadata: tokenizers/hash: f1e2d3 -> b4c5d6. Run `deploy-bot logs rl-2026-2222` for details.

cheng: long-term fix: model bundler should bake a tokenizer runtime checksum and the model loader should fail-fast when runtime tokenizers != bundle checksum. also add unit tests in locale-smoke for katakana adjacency, ideographic punctuation, and bidi punctuation adjacency.

yasmin: agree. i'll open GH issue with failing samples, tokenize diffs, CI gating change, and the detok patch as a short-term PR.

mira: thanks all. i'll paste canary numbers once the detok filter run completes. feel free to add any other quick fixes in this thread.
